experiment: C3 confirmatory recursive Canaria recompilation after joint cluster adaptation
recursive_stage3_target_rule: a0 -> frozen Stage-2 cluster(a0) only; original a3 forbidden as Stage-3 fit target

data_isolation.selection: none; conditions and budgets are locked
data_isolation.test: materialize/evaluate only after all locked models are fitted and validation metrics recorded

P1.statistic: mean paired D_frozen = NMSE(all_unfrozen_recursive, original) - NMSE(all_frozen_recursive, original)

P2.statistic: geometric mean R = NMSE(all_unfrozen_recursive, original) / NMSE(direct_original_single, original)

P3.statistic: mean paired D_edges = NMSE(all_unfrozen_recursive, original) - NMSE(edges_only_recursive, original)

overall_decision: CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff P1, P2, P3, and test safeguard all pass; otherwise CONFIRMATORY_FAIL; retain all seeds
claim_boundary_if_pass: Scoped evidence that, in this residual-MLP digits testbed and matched replacement grammar, an already-fitted three-Canaria cluster can be jointly adapted, frozen, and recursively recompiled from cluster outputs alone with a preregistered bounded fidelity penalty relative to direct original-teacher recompilation. Not universal, not lossless, not arbitrary-depth, not LLM-scale.
